snippet.title: Randel's Quest - Reveal Trailer!
snippet.description:
Randel’s Quest is a slot-driven, Wordle-style roguelike battler.
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4157850/Randels_Quest

Roll the slots for effects, read the color hints and strike with the right word at the right moment! Every word counts. Even the wrong ones!
